items.source: Return the ResolvableType describing this instance (or null if some sort of default should be applied instead).
items.translation: 返回描述此实例的ResolvableType（如果应应用某种默认值，则返回null）。

items.source: Users of this interface should be careful in complex hierarchy scenarios, especially when the generic type signature of the class changes in subclasses. It is always possible to return null to fallback on a default behavior.
items.translation: 使用此接口的用户应在复杂的层次结构场景中格外小心，特别是当子类的泛型类型签名发生变化时。始终可以返回 `null` 以回退到默认行为。

items.source:
Such information is very useful when figuring out if the instance matches a generic
signature as Java does not convey the signature at runtime.
items.translation: 此类信息在判断实例是否匹配泛型签名时非常有用，因为 Java 在运行时不传递泛型签名。
